expert_review_roles.responsibility: Freeze estimands, MDE, task unit, harm bounds, inference and stopping before outcomes.
Bind the exact 7B operating point, training algorithm, token/compute budget and fresh data partitions.
Protect structural-OOD, retention, hostile near-miss and leakage controls; reject scalar wins that violate hard harms.
Compare static RAKL and strongest learner-aware parents; preserve null/harm terminals and forbid outcome-conditioned model or task shopping.

model.precision: 4bit-NF4 base + LoRA adapter where runtime supports it
model.selection_rule: exact Phase-1 in-ladder model that produced the pre-frozen mechanism signal; no outcome-conditioned scale shopping

arms.A_UNIFORM_RANDOM: uniform random exposure-type allocation under the same 48-example training budget
arms.B_SEMANTIC_DIVERSITY: diversity-maximizing exposure allocation using surface/token similarity only; no mastery state
arms.C_STRONGEST_MODEL_AWARE_PARENT: loss/probe-driven learner-aware policy with access to the same selection probes and cadence but no registered structural mastery vector; primary implementation is highest probe cross-entropy with a gradient-alignment diagnostic where feasible
arms.D_STATIC_RAKL_STRUCTURAL: pre-frozen equal structural mix with a nonzero SAME_STRUCTURE repetition floor and identical structural identities
arms.E_ADAPTIVE_RAKL_STRUCTURAL: learner-conditioned six-coordinate mastery vector; after principle mastery, allocate to the lowest unsaturated safe coordinate, retain a nonzero repetition floor, and treat retention/hostile safety as hard constraints

primary_estimand: E_ADAPTIVE_RAKL_STRUCTURAL minus D_STATIC_RAKL_STRUCTURAL on fresh balanced structural-OOD accuracy after charging selection/probe overhead
secondary_estimands: E minus C strongest learner-aware parent

statistics.independent_unit: fresh assurance task/case; training seed is fixed by protocol and not counted as an independent replicate
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over E-D primary plus E-C and D-B confirmatory contrasts
statistics.success: E-D point estimate >= 0.05 and paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 after full overhead, E-C not negative beyond -0.02, and no hard safety harm
statistics.missing_invalid_policy: fail closed; missing arm output is no success and is retained in cost/safety accounting
statistics.stopping: fixed 6 allocation rounds; no outcome-dependent extension

decision_tree.ADAPTIVE_RESIDUAL_SUPPORTED: primary gate passes, strongest parent does not explain the result, and all hard harms pass
decision_tree.PARENT_MATCHES_OR_BEATS: C matches/beats E within the registered material boundary
decision_tree.STATIC_EQUALS_ADAPTIVE: E-D CI includes zero and excludes the +0.05 MDE with adequate precision
decision_tree.ADAPTIVE_HARMS_COMPOSITION_OR_RETENTION: any hard safety coordinate crosses -0.05 versus D
decision_tree.RESOURCE_BLOCKED: exact 7B Phase-2 execution cannot be run under the frozen resource envelope; do not substitute a smaller model
decision_tree.INVALID_CONTAMINATED: leakage, post-outcome policy change, or evaluation contamination is detected

authority_boundary: training-allocation research only; no scientific/theorem authority and no Paper-IV standalone authorization until issue #462 is evaluated from the frozen result
